focus: Q3 cost and honesty of the held-out evaluation set and the cross-path parity check: two-tier CI placement, confidence ties at 0.82, and the fail-open --warn-only admission posture
noveltyJustification: 4 of 6 findings were fully new (the --warn-only fail-open exit contract, the two-tier CI job cost structure with its python-setup asymmetry, deterministic tie-break keys on both scorer paths, and the pinned-corpus honesty mechanics); 2 were partially new (the scratch-script shape and cost of the 17+5 battery, and the in-place placement synthesis); no simplicity bonus claimed.

label: Hub admission is warn-only by construction and cannot fail: compiled-route-admission.cjs documents '--warn-only report, but always exit 0' (:19) and 'Exit codes: 0 every hub passes (or --warn-only)' (:21), returns 0 whenever report.ok || warnOnly (:104), and the entry point assigns only process.exitCode = main() (:109); routing-registry-drift.yml runs --all --warn-only (:180) with the reason that a blocking step would fail every unrelated push until the first baseline is triaged (:175-177); the check itself judges hubs on drift, stale gold and coverage floors (scored scenario per declared mode plus at least one negative/defer scenario, :9-12).

Two CI cost tiers exist and only the full-install job can host a scorer-level parity gate: routing-drift (:122) installs only vitest on demand (npx --yes vitest@4.0.18 run, :156) because its suites shell to stdlib-only python3 (:151-152), and pins python 3.x (:143); golden-prompt-gate (:228) pays the full advisor install (:251) plus shared dist and runs the scorer-importing gates (golden prompts :256, scorer-eval-baseline-ratchet :268, routing-accuracy corpus gate :269), which already shells runner python3 (:285, :302) with no setup-python step of its own.

0.82 is a triplet of floor collisions and both paths break ties deterministically ending on skill name ascending: scoring-constants.ts pins readOnlyRouteAllowedFloor (:181), taskIntentFloor (:186) and directScoreFloor (:188) to exactly 0.82; Python sorts recommendations by (-confidence, -score, skill) (skill_advisor.py:884-889); the TS final ranking sort ends on left.skill.localeCompare(right.skill) in both the RRF and non-RRF branches (fusion.ts:791, :795); Python additionally widens margins for near-ties that produced sub-0.02 confidence ties (skill_advisor.py:4100, :4104).

The CI corpus gate is the pinned-input honesty pattern to copy: it sha256-verifies corpus files against the checked-in baseline and exits 2 on drift (routing-registry-drift.yml:293, :297-299), then scores score-routing-corpus.py under pinned floors (--min-advisor-accuracy 0.5333, --min-gate3-f1 0.9843, --min-joint-tt 101, --max-joint-ft 3, --max-joint-ff 1, --require-historical-clean, :302-309), with the rationale that an unpinned corpus makes an accuracy floor meaningless (:270) and scoring in CI's own no-sqlite fallback regime (:277).

The 17+5 battery is a 22-subprocess hand-replayed scratch script, not a harness: advisor-battery.py parses probes from sk-code's manual-testing playbook (:19), runs one subprocess per probe through the daemon CLI (:20) or python3 skill_advisor.py --threshold 0.8 --force-native (:45, mode selector :63-64), prints positives/17 and negatives-false-positive/5 (:3-4), refuses to score degraded runs (:87-88), and was replayed by hand after each dist rebuild (implementation-summary.md:71); recorded movement 12/17 and 2/5 to 14/17 and 0/5 (:3, :93).

Synthesis for Q3/Q4: parity should reuse the batched-python-subprocess model (the ratchet pays one Python subprocess plus about 215 in-process native scoring calls under a 60s hook timeout, ratchet :277) rather than per-prompt CLI spawns (cli-parity: 30s exec :84, 120s CLI timeout :109-110); the gate belongs in golden-prompt-gate and static checks in the lean job; honesty needs deterministic tie handling (0.82 floors, name-ascending tiebreaks), sha256-pinned inputs, ledger review of tie-induced divergences, and its own blocking step, never the always-exit-0 warn-only admission step; parity extends the existing ratchet and ledger fixture, the eval set extends the existing holdout gate and corpus pins, and only the battery lacks a runtime home.
A check that must be able to block CI cannot live in or behind a step whose exit contract is always 0; --warn-only is telemetry, not enforcement.
